==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Moiraine Damodred]]}}
The next day, [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] continue their clerical duties. There are many more vague references in the census, expanding their criteria for the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Moiriane begins rehearsing careful questions for the new mothers. [[Tamra Ospenya]] visits them, thinking that the previous day would have cured their appetites for boredom. Moiraine gives another [[Aes Sedai]] answer, saying that "the lists help me govern my thoughts, Mother." The [[Amyrlin Seat]] says that they may continue so long as their studies do not suffer. The Amyrlin then hands Moiraine a note to be taken to [[Kerene Nagashi]], sealed with green wax.

[[File:Elyas Machera.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Elyas Machera, a Warder.]]
[[File:Waylin.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Waylin, a Warder.]]
Moiraine goes to the [[Green Ajah]] quarters. She sees tapestries on the walls depicting battles and long-dead nations. She also sees several [[Warder]]s. She passes [[Rina Hafden]] watching two of her Warders, [[Waylin]] and [[Elyas Machera]], practicing. She also passes [[Jala Bandevin]], who is watching her round-faced Warder play a flute.

She comes to Kerene's door, noticing the sword lacquered in red, gold and black. Moiraine thinks that the lacquering is important, but most likely it is an Ajah secret. Along with a few tapestries of scenes of war or hunting, there are several other items: a few books, animal skulls, different bowls, odd-shaped vases, various weapons, a fat firedrop, a stopped gilded barrel clock, and a blood-stained steel-backed gauntlet, among others. Also in Kerene's rooms is a row of painted miniatures of her long-deceased family - a plump man, a smiling woman, three girls and two boys. Her Warders, [[Karile]] and [[Stepin]], are in Kerene's rooms as well, Karile reading and Stepin playing a bittern. Neither of them stop what they are doing when Moiraine enters.

[[File:Kerene Nagashi.jpg|thumb|right|200px|"Tamra wants me ''urgently'', but she doesn't say why."]]
Kerene, tall and slim with black eyes and dark hair, takes the message and reads it quickly. Before she is done, both of her Warders prepare to depart. Moiraine asks if there will be a reply, but Kerene says that she will carry the reply herself. She mutters to her Warders that the Amyrlin wants to see her urgently.

As Moiraine returns to her workplace, Siuan has another note to be taken to [[Aisha Raveneos]], a [[Gray Ajah|Gray]] sister. Siuan wonders why the Amyrlin wants a Gray and a Green. Thanks to her knowledge with the [[Daes Dae'mar|Game of Houses]], Moiraine deduces that the Amyrlin wants [[Tamra Ospenya's Searchers|searchers]] to look for the boy-child. She also thinks that the Amyrlin intends for these trusted sisters to protect and educate the Dragon Reborn, rather than have him be brought to the Tower which would expose him to the [[Red Ajah]]. Siuan is amazed at Moiraine's extrapolations from so little information, but Moiraine thinks Siuan has enough skill with puzzles to do similarly.

The next day, Tamra Ospenya leaves three more notes to be taken to sisters; [[Meilyn Arganya]] of the [[White Ajah]], [[Valera Gorovni]] of the [[Brown Ajah]] and [[Ludice Daneen]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. Moiraine knows that all five sisters have worn the [[shawl]] more than a century and all share a reputation for the strict adherence to the law.

It is announced that [[Aeldra Najaf]] is raised to the [[Keeper of the Chronicles]] to replace [[Gitara Moroso]]. Aeldra catches Moiraine trying to look into the Amyrlin's study and apartments to see if there might be any more searchers. Moiraine says that she is just looking at the sisters going in and out of the study and Aeldra takes this as Moiraine dreaming of the shawl. She also asks after Moiraine's bad dreams. Aeldra tells Moiraine that one of the Brown sisters might have an herb to help her sleep, but [[Verin Mathwin]] has already given her something. Despite her acceptance of Moiraine's excuses and situation, Aeldra says that if she catches Moiraine "daydreaming" in doorways again, she will "have to take notice."
